1elear4: Wendel Elear arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F10 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Wendel Elear started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Elear. Wendel Elear read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Wendel Elear helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Wendel Elear's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point." Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Elear. Wendel Elear read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Hand mended the hole in Wendel Elear's trousers with fishing line and a bent pin. Wendel says the patch is stronger than the trousers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Elear. Wendel Elear read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Wendel Elear read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here."

Wendel Elear and Hugo Suzumi carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Wendel Elear. Wendel Elear read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Wendel Elear is Lance Corporal now. At supper, a recruit waited for him to sit before taking a place. He noticed.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Wendel Elear in the open at U-F10. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Ivo "Button" Denv of the Concord (@denv04). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Wendel Elear fell at U-F10 and never moved again. Shot by Ivo "Button" Denv of the Concord (@denv04).
Rafael Elear arrived carrying the family name of Wendel Elear. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Rafael carried a bag of mail through a shelled trench. Every letter arrived. Two had mud on them.
benmarine7: Matthias Benmarine arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-F6 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Matthias Benmarine read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A rat stole Matthias Benmarine's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Matthias Benmarine watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A patient at the aid post asked Matthias Benmarine for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen.
Matthias Benmarine lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Matthias Benmarine asks about each detail while changing the dressing.

A bullet clipped Matthias Benmarine's helmet at T-F6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Timucin of the Hegemony (@halil.ibrahim.timucin).
Matthias Benmarine returned to T-F6 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.

Matthias Benmarine was hit in the hip at T-F6. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr). Matthias Benmarine was hit at T-F6 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Leopold "Parson" Carlosm of the Hegemony (@carlosm.jr).
Karel "Whistle" Benmarine arrived carrying the family name of Matthias Benmarine. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
On sentry duty Karel watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
bezuidenhoutzander0: On Day 15 Quentin "Whistle" Bezuidenhout took a post at N-F5 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He laughs at exactly the wrong moments, and the men liked him for it.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At N-F5 they left Quentin "Whistle" Bezuidenhout behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Dooficus of the Concord (@dooficus).
Leopold Bezuidenhout put a lucky button beside the bunk. Someone who had known Quentin "Whistle" Bezuidenhout helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Leopold Bezuidenhout was hit through the stomach at N-F5. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Walter "Mud" Xhanley of the Concord (@josh_xhanley). Leopold Bezuidenhout was killed at N-F5 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Walter "Mud" Xhanley of the Concord (@josh_xhanley).
Gustav Bezuidenhout came to the front because his older brother Leopold Bezuidenhout never came home. He carries a lucky button.
Gustav and Silas Evan made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
bubik_233: The new rifleman is Tobias Bubik, once a printer's apprentice from Tannenfeld. The corporal asked if a printer's apprentice was any use in a trench. Tobias Bubik said he would find out.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Tobias Bubik heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Tobias Bubik and Norbert Littlesaint sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Bubik answered to number 918. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Bubik watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Tobias Bubik was carrying water up to R-R5 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Tobias Bubik did not. Shot by Gustav Filipentav of the Hegemony (@filipentav). Tobias Bubik was killed on watch at R-R5. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Gustav Filipentav of the Hegemony (@filipentav).
Felix Bubik put a stub of a pencil beside the bunk. Someone who had known Tobias Bubik helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Felix Bubik was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Zeno Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).
Felix Bubik's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Felix Bubik fired at a movement across the wire at R-R5. The man went down: Bram Pastaeaterxa, grazed.
Felix "Button" Diks and Felix Bubik spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

Felix Bubik fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Gustav Marksebastio was badly wounded. The sergeant at R-R5 called out a range and a spot. Felix Bubik was the only one who hit it. Tobias Euphoria was grazed.

Felix was hit in the neck at R-R5. The medic pressed both hands over the wound and did not let go for a long time. Shot by Emil Icespiceynod of the Hegemony (@icespiceynoddlrs). Felix was killed outright at R-R5, a single bullet from across the wire.
Viktor "Hollow" Bubik arrived carrying the family name of Felix Bubik. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
cade42623: On Day 9, Quentin Cade arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-C15, Quentin Cade listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Quentin Cade saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-C15 and fired once. Hugo Jameson was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin Cade is number 692. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Quentin Cade watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The corporal found out Quentin Cade used to be a farmhand. Quentin Cade has been doing two jobs ever since.
Quentin Cade followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Quentin Cade pulled Bastian Idkvariable out of a flooded shell hole at the Bone Quarry. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Quentin Cade borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.

Quentin Cade counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Dorian "Brick" Bliss was grazed. A bullet hit Quentin Cade in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-C15. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Bram Jozsef of the Hegemony (@kolonics.akos.jozsef).

Fever took hold of Quentin Cade overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Quentin Cade was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
The worst is over for Quentin. He asked for a cigarette and the nurse said no. He asked again and she said maybe tomorrow.
chubkis117: Arno Chubkis signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-F1 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Arno Chubkis. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. Arno Chubkis walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Arno Chubkis pulled Casimir Therealstycx out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Arno Chubkis remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Arno Chubkis agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
The artist tried again while Arno Chubkis read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Arno Chubkis was on watch at Q-F1 when the night raid hit. The men found Arno Chubkis at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Arno Eversonae of the Concord (@eversonae).
Leopold Chubkis put a pocket Bible with a hole in it beside the bunk. Someone who had known Arno Chubkis helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Leopold Chubkis measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Leopold said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
colinhydee: Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Benedikt Preston came out for a cup and was grazed. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F5. Benedikt Preston was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee fired. Gideon Northerncoun was grazed.
Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Karel Minopeo was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee tried to describe the smell of Greyhallow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.
A newspaper reached Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Albin Fossileyezd of the Concord and Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at Hill 304. It is getting crowded.
Jakub found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
da_moovin: Day 4: Leopold "Brick" Moovin reached S-F19 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
A clear shot from S-F19. Leopold "Brick" Moovin grazed Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong and slid back down below the parapet.

Leopold "Brick" Moovin lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Brick" Moovin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet went through Leopold "Brick" Moovin's sleeve at S-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga of the Hegemony (@filip_ogwanga). Leopold "Brick" Moovin had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor crossed it, Leopold "Brick" Moovin fired. Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor was gravely wounded.
Leopold "Brick" Moovin no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A shell hit the latrine at S-F19. Nobody was hurt. Leopold "Brick" Moovin says it was the best day of the war.
The parcel for Leopold "Brick" Moovin contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.

The Hegemony raiders came over at S-F19 in the middle of the night. Leopold "Brick" Moovin met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Felix "Bones" Kurlkale of the Hegemony (@kurlkale).
The House of Moovin sent Pavel Moovin after Leopold "Brick" Moovin. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F19. Pavel Moovin fired at the last man to run. Quentin "Shadow" Clan was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Pavel Moovin is number 260. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Moovin kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Pavel Moovin counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Quentin "Shadow" Clan was badly wounded.

A shell landed square in S-F19. They found Pavel Moovin alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Pavel Moovin was carrying ammunition to S-F19 when the shell landed. They found the box. They did not find Pavel Moovin.
Severin Moovin took the same post at S-F19 where Pavel Moovin stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Severin Moovin waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Albin "Whistle" Gossett did, and was badly wounded.
Severin Moovin had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Casimir Cbeattie was badly wounded.

Severin Moovin was on the dawn watch at S-F19 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Severin Moovin was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Ulrich Zelenszki of the Hegemony (@_zelenszki_).
Severin Moovin's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Severin borrowed a razor and returned it cleaner than before. It was the first compliment the owner had had in weeks.
jwessels530: Ulrich Jwessels came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. The transfer made Ulrich Jwessels a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. Ulrich Jwessels bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

On a quiet night Matthias Mart (Concord) and Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Jwessels crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at R-F4 holds again. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 has been won. Ulrich Jwessels listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Ulrich Jwessels caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Ulrich Jwessels was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
Ulrich Jwessels followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Tobias Noirangelfan (Concord) at Blackwater Canal. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich Jwessels watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A pump handle snapped off in Ulrich Jwessels's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ulrich Jwessels is number 244. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ulrich Jwessels shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
A man asked Ulrich Jwessels to describe Greyhallow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Ulrich Jwessels found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Ulrich Jwessels tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at R-F7 is up.

Ulrich Jwessels traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A letter from home found Ulrich Jwessels before the night shift. Ulrich Jwessels folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Jwessels hummed an old song from home on sentry. From the other side of the wire, very faintly, someone hummed it back. A letter for Ulrich Jwessels said the whole street was asking about the front. Ulrich Jwessels did not know where to begin the answer.

Ulrich Jwessels sang the first verse tonight, out loud. The other side sang the second. Nobody fired for an hour. The letter for Ulrich Jwessels was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Ulrich Jwessels liked the crossed-out parts best.

Ulrich was hit through the stomach at R-F4. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci). When a bed came free, Ulrich was the first on the list. The field hospital had never looked so good. Ulrich's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
lagbagdotzip: Severin Lagbagdotzip came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Severin Lagbagdotzip fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Quentin "Shadow" Danny, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. After what happened at Verdel Ridge, Severin Lagbagdotzip asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Severin Lagbagdotzip. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.

Severin Lagbagdotzip wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Severin Lagbagdotzip during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Severin Lagbagdotzip fired at a movement across the wire at R-F19. The man went down: Teodor Deanc, grazed. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F19 and grazed Severin Lagbagdotzip's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia of the Concord (@rachelejosiah). A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Severin Lagbagdotzip is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.
Severin Lagbagdotzip owes Felix Lowelleast so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.

Severin Lagbagdotzip wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Severin Lagbagdotzip used it. Ivo "Ghost" Someonenamed was badly wounded. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Severin Lagbagdotzip listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet grazed Severin Lagbagdotzip's ribs at R-F19. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Severin Lagbagdotzip is number 212. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Severin Lagbagdotzip did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

The medic cut the last bandage off Severin Lagbagdotzip's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F19 the same hour. A letter from home found Severin Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Severin Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet went through Severin Lagbagdotzip's upper arm at R-F19 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_). Severin Lagbagdotzip was killed at R-F19 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_).
Viktor Lagbagdotzip put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Severin Lagbagdotzip helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor Lagbagdotzip across the shin at R-F19. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Florian "Lucky" Nistico of the Concord (@rafaelle_nistico).

Viktor Lagbagdotzip walked back up the communication trench to R-F19, slower than before, but on his own feet. A letter from home found Viktor Lagbagdotzip before the night shift. Viktor Lagbagdotzip folded it small and kept it close. Viktor Lagbagdotzip transferred to the sappers. The men in R-F19 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.
Viktor Lagbagdotzip reached up to fix a sandbag at R-F19 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_).
Viktor Lagbagdotzip's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Viktor borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. The runner said a letter for Viktor had come up with the ammunition. Viktor went to get it before the ammunition.
manthatsmental1: Konrad Manthatsment arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Konrad "Mud" Pawington, grazed. Konrad Manthatsment cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Konrad Manthatsment wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Konrad Manthatsment drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. After the loss of Grey Mill, Konrad Manthatsment helped stack spare sandbags at Q-S7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Konrad Manthatsment warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move.

Konrad Manthatsment was carrying water up to Q-S7 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Konrad Manthatsment did not. Shot by Karel Pasoslargos of the Hegemony (@pasoslargos100). Konrad Manthatsment was killed outright at Q-S7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Karel Pasoslargos of the Hegemony (@pasoslargos100).
Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment joined Q-S7 under the shadow of Konrad Manthatsment's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-S7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Henrik Houghton of the Hegemony (@patrick.houghton.5602).
Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment and Dorian Connorgarnoc share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Valentin "Owl" Manthatsment won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in Q-S7. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Valentin unpacked a crate of tins and counted them twice. There were eleven. The list said twelve.
maupat_03: Ivo Maupat arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a photograph gone soft at the edges and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ivo Maupat could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Face blackened with soot, Ivo Maupat spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Karel Jonas was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo Maupat is number 784. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Ivo Maupat folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Ivo Maupat caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Ivo Maupat let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Emil Szko was grazed.
Ivo Maupat waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Quentin Rocco did, and was badly wounded.
Ivo Maupat washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.

Machine-gun fire swept S-C11. Ivo Maupat took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Isidor Eccentricred of the Concord (@eccentricredeye). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Ivo Maupat fell at S-C11 and never moved again. Shot by Isidor Eccentricred of the Concord (@eccentricredeye).
The House of Maupat sent another. Casimir "Button" Maupat, brother of Ivo Maupat, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Casimir "Button" Maupat was waiting. Clement Callmequeeno was grazed.
Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord traded a button for a cigarette with Casimir through a hole in the wall at Blackwater Canal. Both pretended it never happened.
myx_nyx: Tobias Nyx arrived at V-F13 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Tobias Nyx left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. A letter from home found Tobias Nyx before the night shift. Tobias Nyx folded it small and kept it close. The signallers took Tobias Nyx in on a busy morning in V-F13. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Tobias Nyx crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at V-F13 holds again. A letter from home found Tobias Nyx before the night shift. Tobias Nyx folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias Nyx held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms. A letter from home found Tobias Nyx before the night shift. Tobias Nyx folded it small and kept it close.
Tobias Nyx was the last raider out of the enemy trench, covering the others. The others made it home. Tobias Nyx did not.
The House of Nyx sent another. Jakub "Ash" Nyx, father of Tobias Nyx, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Jakub "Ash" Nyx was hit in the thigh crossing Lantern Hill. He crawled the last yards back to the trench on his elbows. The beds were full. Jakub "Ash" Nyx waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth. A thin letter reached Jakub "Ash" Nyx. Only five lines long, and Jakub "Ash" Nyx knew every one of them by heart before supper.

Jakub lay a night and a day on a stretcher in the open trench. Then he stood up, shook out the blanket and went back to V-F13. A small parcel arrived for Jakub: a pencil and a pad of paper. The note said: write to us. Jakub began at once.
pgallo102: Ulrich Pgallo was a tram conductor in Rosenau until the posters went up. He came to S-F5 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he is always the first one awake. The transfer made Ulrich Pgallo a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.
Ulrich Pgallo wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Ulrich Pgallo lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.

Ulrich Pgallo took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Victory at Hill 304. Ulrich Pgallo let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A bullet went through Ulrich Pgallo's sleeve at S-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).
Ulrich Pgallo's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A bullet grazed Ulrich Pgallo's ribs at S-F5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).

Ulrich Pgallo was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars). Ulrich Pgallo stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F5. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar of the Concord (@corporalstars).
Ivo Pgallo had heard about Ulrich Pgallo's courage. At S-F5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Ivo Pgallo folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A recruit asked Ivo Pgallo how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Ivo Pgallo answered to number 202. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Ivo Pgallo did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A bullet hit Ivo Pgallo's belt buckle at S-F5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple).
Ivo Pgallo came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
The old Private did not come back from the wire. Ivo Pgallo wears his stripes now: Lance Corporal.

Ivo Pgallo and the recruit have reached whole words. Lessons take place beside the stove, with spelling corrections from people pretending not to listen. Ivo Pgallo asked to leave the runners and serve as a machine gunner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
Ivo Pgallo began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Ivo Pgallo was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

Ivo fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Clement "Bones" Xman was badly wounded. A bullet passed so close to Ivo at S-F5 that it burned his neck. The sergeant told him to count that as a haircut. Shot by Zeno Manningwam of the Concord (@manningwam).
poysner: Valentin "Saint" Poysner arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

An empty jam tin became Valentin "Saint" Poysner's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Valentin "Saint" Poysner wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Valentin "Saint" Poysner. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Valentin "Saint" Poysner drew the street leading to Esterhaus. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

A bullet hit Valentin "Saint" Poysner in the neck at U-F22. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Pavel "Bones" Emayne of the Hegemony (@emayne2026). Valentin "Saint" Poysner fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Marek Rdan, gravely wounded. Valentin "Saint" Poysner looked over the parapet at U-F22 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Pavel "Bones" Emayne of the Hegemony (@emayne2026).
Roland "Bones" Poysner arrived carrying the family name of Valentin "Saint" Poysner. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet hit Roland "Bones" Poysner in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at U-F22. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Norbert Rdan of the Hegemony (@al_rdan). A single shot at U-F22. Roland "Bones" Poysner sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Norbert Rdan of the Hegemony (@al_rdan).
Hugo Poysner put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Roland "Bones" Poysner helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Hugo Poysner rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Oskar Rdan was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
A clear shot from U-F22. Hugo Poysner badly wounded Oskar Rdan and slid back down below the parapet.
Isidor Amin and Hugo Poysner sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
skootybazooms: Ivo Skootybazoom introduced himself as a railway porter from Esterhaus. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
A pump handle snapped off in Ivo Skootybazoom's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Ivo Skootybazoom counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
Ivo Skootybazoom fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Marek Tony, grazed.
A note came over the wire at the Bone Quarry, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci.' Ivo Skootybazoom sang louder.
Ivo Skootybazoom and Dietrich Notceyshhauc carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Ivo and Wendel Rebootreboot tried to teach the squad a song in two languages. The squad learned the wrong half of each.
stonewall.61: "You're late," said the corporal when Jonas Stonewall arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Blackwater Canal is lost. Jonas Stonewall heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

On sentry duty Jonas Stonewall watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Jonas Stonewall watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The shelling stopped while Jonas Stonewall was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
A flare lit Saint-Ash crossroads like noon. Jonas Stonewall counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
The gas alarm sounded during supper. Jonas Stonewall put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Jonas Stonewall fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Jonas Stonewall heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
Jonas Stonewall watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Jonas held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.
thedukeofvelour: Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel came up on Day 10 carrying news from Wyvern Cross. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel in the open at P-F15. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Yann Watt of the Hegemony (@jake_watt1236). Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel looked over the parapet at P-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Yann Watt of the Hegemony (@jake_watt1236).

Jakub Thedukeofvel asked about Roland "Saint" Thedukeofvel on arriving at P-F15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jakub Thedukeofvel wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' After what happened at the Brickworks, Jakub Thedukeofvel asked to serve as a chaplain. Nobody argued.

Jakub Thedukeofvel was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers. A letter from home found Jakub Thedukeofvel before the night shift. Jakub Thedukeofvel folded it small and kept it close.
The list for Jakub Thedukeofvel's gathering contains a poem, a song and a request for five minutes without orders. All three seem possible.

Jakub Thedukeofvel traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch. A letter from home found Jakub Thedukeofvel before the night shift. Jakub Thedukeofvel folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub Thedukeofvel was hit through the stomach at P-F15. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Dorian "Spark" Canales of the Hegemony (@lucas.canales55). A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Jakub Thedukeofvel. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
Jakub Thedukeofvel recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through.
Jakub Thedukeofvel returned to P-F15 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.

Jakub held the gathering in a shelter after supper. The poem was read badly, the song went better, and nobody interrupted the silence. Jakub got a letter in a child's handwriting. Every sentence started with 'Please' and ended with 'Come back.' Jakub had to go and stand outside for a minute.
theexpendableguard: The quartermaster asked Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl and Pavel Huntertheyan both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Across the wire at Grey Mill, Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.

Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at Q-F19 holds again. Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl was hit in the forearm at Q-F19. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Teodor Blight of the Hegemony (@blight_802).
The medic cut the last bandage off Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-F19 the same hour.

Quentin "Whistle" Thenightradi (Hegemony) and Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl (Concord) came to the same broken well at Saint-Ash crossroads at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Wendel "Ash" Theexpendabl ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.'
Wendel and Pavel Huntertheyan cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
tomtomaustheim: By the time Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe reached R-R9, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 791. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

A bullet grazed Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe's ribs at R-R9. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo of the Hegemony (@titlefightlover37). Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Quentin "Hollow" Titlefightlo did not get to reply at all, grazed.
Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe was hit in the hip at R-R9. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88). A clear shot from R-R9. Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe grazed Anselm Ryan and slid back down below the parapet.
Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Matthias "Ash" Tomtomausthe survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at R-R9, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Matthias aimed a step ahead and fired: Wendel Realshayanwo, grazed.
volodymyr_kryvolap: The draft reached Q-F1 on Day 9. Edmund Kryvolap was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Edmund Kryvolap kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Henrik Barringarms and Edmund Kryvolap tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Edmund Kryvolap looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Edmund Kryvolap started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Edmund Kryvolap's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Edmund Kryvolap's ear at Q-F1 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Silas Isaiahfs of the Hegemony (@isaiahfs21).
The wound on Edmund Kryvolap's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Edmund Kryvolap read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here."
Asked what he wanted after the war, Edmund Kryvolap said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Edmund watched a patrol leave the trench at Q-F1 and counted them out. Later he counted them in.
